class.name: OcgTransferTransferiterator
class.brief_description: Defines an Iterator on the result of a Transfer Available for Normal Results or not (Erroneous Transfer) It gives several kinds of Information, and allows to consider various criteria (criteria are cumulative)
class.description: ! Defines an Iterator on the result of a Transfer ! Available for Normal Results or not (Erroneous Transfer) ! It gives several kinds of Information, and allows to consider ! various criteria (criteria are cumulative)

method.name: Transfer_TransferIterator
method.description: Creates an empty Iterator

method.name: AddItem
method.description: Adds a Binder to the iteration list (construction)

method.name: SelectBinder
method.description: Selects Items on the Type of Binder : keep only Binders which are of a given Type (if keep is True) or reject only them (if keep is False)

method.name: SelectResult
method.description: Selects Items on the Type of Result. Considers only Unique Results. Considers Dynamic Type for Transient Result, Static Type (the one given to define the Binder) else.

method.name: SelectUnique
method.description: Select Items according Unicity : keep only Unique Results (if keep is True) or keep only Multiple Results (if keep is False)

method.name: SelectItem
method.description: Selects/Unselect (according to <keep> an item designated by its rank <num> in the list Used by sub-classes which have specific criteria

method.name: Number
method.description: Returns count of Binders to be iterated

method.name: Start
method.description: Clears Iteration in progress, to allow it to be restarted

method.name: More
method.description: Returns True if there are other Items to iterate

method.name: Next
method.description: Sets Iteration to the next Item

method.name: Value
method.description: Returns the current Binder

method.name: HasResult
method.description: Returns True if current Item brings a Result, Transient (Handle) or not or Multiple. That is to say, if it corresponds to a normally achieved Transfer, Transient Result is read by specific TransientResult below. Other kind of Result must be read specifically from its Binder

method.name: HasUniqueResult
method.description: Returns True if Current Item has a Unique Result

method.name: ResultType
method.description: Returns the Type of the Result of the current Item, if Unique. If No Unique Result (Error Transfer or Multiple Result), returns a Null Handle The Type is : the Dynamic Type for a Transient Result, the Type defined by the Binder Class else

method.name: HasTransientResult
method.description: Returns True if the current Item has a Transient Unique Result (if yes, use TransientResult to get it)

method.name: TransientResult
method.description: Returns the Transient Result of the current Item if there is (else, returns a null Handle) Supposes that Binding is done by a SimpleBinderOfTransient

method.name: Status
method.description: Returns Execution Status of current Binder Normal transfer corresponds to StatusDone

method.name: HasFails
method.description: Returns True if Fail Messages are recorded with the current Binder. They can then be read through Check (see below)

method.name: HasWarnings
method.description: Returns True if Warning Messages are recorded with the current Binder. They can then be read through Check (see below)

method.name: Check
method.description: Returns Check associated to current Binder (in case of error, it brings Fail messages) (in case of warnings, it brings Warning messages)
